selected_evidence.requirement: Nginx serves a successful HTTP response at `/` on TCP port 6700
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after restart, Nginx was active and enabled, listened on port 6700, passed configuration validation, and returned HTTP 200 with body `nginx on port 6700` via node1's managed IP.

selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent SELinux and firewall access for TCP 6700
selected_evidence.summary: TCP 6700 is labeled http_port_t and permanently allowed by firewalld; both remained effective after restart.

Healthy baseline used boot ID a1be807a-f931-4328-b608-cd61f894ed55; restart was acknowledged; node returned with changed boot ID 56e06151-7c5d-4b9e-a525-bd2477efdea8; Nginx, listeners, firewall, SELinux mapping, configuration, and HTTP 200 response all recovered.
